description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to security context visibility and filtering, implemented using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions like evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility, shouldIncludeSupplementalContext, and filterSupplementalContextItems.

methods.name: evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates whether supplemental context should be included based on mode, kind, and sender permissions.

methods.name: shouldIncludeSupplementalContext
methods.description: Determines if a supplemental context item should be included based on mode, kind, and sender allowance.

methods.name: filterSupplementalContextItems
methods.description: Filters the list of supplemental context items based on sender permission and mode, returning the filtered items and omission count.
